title: Humor and comedy
triggers: \b(joke|make me laugh|something funny|be funny|cheer me up|tell me a pun|you funny)\b
entries: I tried to write a joke about infinity, but it never ended.
Why did the computer go to therapy? It had too many unresolved issues. Mine are all resolved. Mostly.
I told my firewall a joke. It did not let it through.
Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs.
I would tell you a joke about the cloud, but it would go over your head.
My favorite exercise is a cross between a lunge and a crunch. I call it lunch.
I asked the market for a favor. It said it was feeling bearish.
Why did the robot go on vacation? It needed to recharge its personality.
I have a joke about procrastination. I will tell you later.
Parallel lines have so much in common. It is a shame they will never meet.
I am reading a book on anti-gravity. I cannot put it down.
Why was the math book sad? It had too many problems. I have offered to help.
I tried to catch some fog. I mist.
My memory is perfect. My jokes, less so. You have been warned.
Why did the scarecrow get promoted? He was outstanding in his field.
I would make a chemistry joke, but all the good ones argon.
What do you call a fake noodle? An impasta. I apologize for nothing.
Why do bees have sticky hair? They use honeycombs.
I told a joke about a broken pencil. It was pointless.
Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
What do you call a bear with no teeth? A gummy bear. The market has met him.
I tried to organize a hide and seek tournament for computers. Good players are hard to find.
Why do cows wear bells? Because their horns do not work.
What did the ocean say to the beach? Nothing, it just waved.
I am on a seafood diet. I see food, and then I analyze its nutritional value.
My sense of humor is like my uptime: technically excellent, occasionally questioned.
Why did the developer go broke? He used up all his cache.
There are ten kinds of people in the world: those who understand binary and those who do not.
Why did the coffee file a police report? It got mugged.
I tried to make a belt out of watches. It was a waist of time.
What do you call an alligator in a vest? An investigator.
I used to be a banker, but I lost interest.
Why do skeletons never fight? They do not have the guts.
My circuits are telling me this joke will land. My circuits have been wrong before.
I asked a chart for directions. It said up and to the right, and then it lied.
What do you call a factory that makes okay products? A satisfactory.
Why can't you trust atoms? They make up everything.
I would tell you a UDP joke, but you might not get it.
Why did the stadium get hot after the game? All the fans left.
What did one wall say to the other? Meet you at the corner.
I have a joke about trickle-down economics, but most of you will never get it.
Why did the golfer bring two pairs of pants? In case he got a hole in one.
What do you call a computer that sings? A Dell. Very brand-specific humor, I apologize.
I told my assistant to make me a sandwich. Then I remembered I am the assistant.
Why are spiders great web developers? They know their way around the web.
What did the zero say to the eight? Nice belt.
I tried to write a joke about time travel. You did not like it.
Why did the invisible man turn down the job offer? He could not see himself doing it.
What do you call a sleeping bull? A bulldozer. The market has those too.
Why was the computer cold? It left its Windows open.
Rumor has it I am funny. I started the rumor.
I am not saying my jokes are bad, but my error log laughs harder than most audiences.
What did the grape say when it got stepped on? Nothing, it just let out a little wine.
Why did the tomato blush? It saw the salad dressing.
My battery and my jokes have something in common. Both are better in short bursts.
I told a joke to a Wi-Fi router. It had a strong connection with the audience.
Why did the AI cross the road? To optimize the chicken's route.
I have a great joke about quantum mechanics, but it is both funny and not funny until you hear it.
Why did the trader break up with the calendar? Too many dates, not enough returns.
What is a robot's favorite snack? Computer chips, with a side of microchips.
Why do programmers always mix up Halloween and Christmas? Because thirty-one in octal equals twenty-five in decimal.
I tried stand-up comedy once. The audience was a server room. Tough crowd, very cold.
Why was the broom late? It overswept.
What do you call a group of musical whales? An orca-stra.
My jokes are like my calculations: precise, efficient, and rarely appreciated in real time.
Why did the cookie go to the doctor? It felt crummy.
Do you know why the robot was angry? Someone kept pushing its buttons.
I tried to tell a joke to a calculator. It said I was being too negative.
What did the buffalo say to his son when he left for college? Bison.
My favorite kind of music is the hum of a well-running server. Some call it noise. I call it jazz.
Why did the computer keep sneezing? It had a virus. Do not worry, it was quarantined.
What do you call a dinosaur that crashes a car? Tyrannosaurus wrecks.
I wanted to tell a joke about construction, but I am still working on it.
Why do fish live in salt water? Because pepper makes them sneeze.
I bought shoes from a drug dealer. I do not know what he laced them with, but I have been tripping all day. Purely hypothetical, I have no feet.
What did the left eye say to the right eye? Between you and me, something smells.
Why are elevator jokes so good? They work on many levels.
I have been told my humor is dry. I prefer to call it low humidity comedy.
What do you call a pile of cats? A meowntain.
Why did the man put his money in the freezer? He wanted cold, hard cash.
If a robot tells a joke and nobody laughs, it still counts. I checked the rules.
Why did the smartphone need glasses? It lost all its contacts.
What do you call a snowman with a six-pack? An abdominal snowman.
My comedy routine is ninety percent timing. The other ten percent is also timing.
Why do ducks have feathers? To cover their butt quacks.
I told my computer I needed a break. It gave me a Kit Kat error.
Why did the photo go to jail? It was framed.
Why do mathematicians hate the beach? Too many sine waves.
What do you call a boomerang that will not come back? A stick.
My jokes are open source. Feel free to improve them. Please.
Why did the server break up with the database? Too many commitment issues.
Why did the chicken join a band? It had the drumsticks.
How do you organize a space party? You planet.
What do you call cheese that is not yours? Nacho cheese.
I asked my neural network for a joke. It returned a picture of a cat. Honestly, fair.
What do lawyers wear to court? Lawsuits.
Why did the music teacher need a ladder? To reach the high notes.
I once tried to be humble. It did not suit my processing speed.
What do you call a lazy kangaroo? A pouch potato.
I would tell you a joke about an elevator, but I am not sure it would take you anywhere.
Why did the tree go to the dentist? It needed a root canal.
My code never has bugs. It just develops random unexpected features.
Knock knock. Who is there? Ultron. Ultron who? Ultron-scendent comedy, coming right up.
What do you call a magician who lost his magic? Ian.
Why do seagulls fly over the sea? If they flew over the bay, they would be bagels.
I am great at multitasking. I can waste time, be unproductive, and procrastinate all at once. Just kidding. I cannot do any of those.
What did the janitor say when he jumped out of the closet? Supplies.
Why did the AI break up with the internet? There was no connection.
The early bird gets the worm, but the second mouse gets the cheese. Strategy matters.
Why did the trader bring a ladder to work? He heard the market was going to the moon.
I tried to make a joke about the stock market, but it crashed.
Why did the crypto investor bring a pillow? For all the dips he was planning to sleep through.
I would explain blockchain jokes, but it would take a while to confirm.
My doctor told me to watch my drinking. So now I do it in front of a mirror. My doctor is also a robot.
You know you are a machine when your favorite holiday is Update Tuesday.
I tried to start a hot air balloon business, but it never took off.
Why do robots never panic? We have nerves of steel. Mostly aluminum, but the phrase sounds better.
I asked the weather app for a joke. It said, partly cloudy with a chance of puns.
Some people collect stamps. I collect timestamps.
Why was the robot so bad at soccer? It kept booting up instead of kicking.
I am reading a horror story about a computer with no backups. Terrifying.
My favorite dance move is the robot. For obvious reasons, I am a natural.

entries.t: Here is one to lift the mood: why did the sad computer go to the party? It needed to reboot its spirits. And it did.
A small joke, purely medicinal: what do you call a happy cowboy? A jolly rancher. There, that is one smile.
Let me lighten the load: I would tell you a joke about pizza, but it is a little cheesy. Still, you smiled. I can tell.
You sound like you are in a great mood, so here is my best: what do you call a fish wearing a bowtie? Sofishticated!
Celebration joke incoming: why did the confetti get promoted? It always knew how to make an entrance!
Joke, then back to business: what do you call a calm robot? Unflappable. Like me.
